Ohne Team-Zugriff siehst du weiterhin nur öffentliche, aktive Produkte.

warp.bot: Use this when the user wants to see their available products, materials, billable items, or manage the catalog including private and inactive rows. Results are paginated — use page/perPage and read meta.lastPage/meta.total for more, or pass search/category to narrow. Pass team as the team slug. Team members get the full catalog without extra flags; outsiders only see public active products. Category filter uses the first product tag; use __untagged__ for products without tags.

inputs.name: Page

description.en: Page number for pagination (default 1)
description.de: Seitennummer für Pagination (Standard 1)

inputs.bot: 1-based page number. Omit for the first page.

description.en: Number of results per page (max 50)
description.de: Ergebnisse pro Seite (max. 50)

inputs.name: search

description.en: Search products by name
description.de: Produkte nach Name suchen

inputs.bot: Optional name search. Prefer this over paging through large catalogs when looking for one product.

inputs.name: category

description.en: Filter by category (first product tag), or __untagged__
description.de: Nach Kategorie filtern (erster Produkt-Tag) oder __untagged__

inputs.bot: Optional. First tag is the category. Use __untagged__ for products without tags. Category options come from GET /v1/products/categories.

inputs.name: Team

description.en: Team slug to list products for. Defaults to the current team.
description.de: Team-Slug, für das Produkte angezeigt werden. Standardmäßig das aktuelle Team.

inputs.bot: The slug of the team whose products to list. Omit to use the current team.
